guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：容器編排叢集
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Container-orchestration clusters
guides.concept: 以宣告式控制、排程與工作負載隔離連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect declarative control, scheduling and workload isolation through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「宣告狀態」的資料、控制與時間關係。宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫 reconcile 的迭代。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「etcd 依賴」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制狀態依賴耐久一致儲存。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「區分 API 與 workload 存活。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「拓撲分佈」的資料、控制與時間關係。分散副本減少共同故障曝露。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同節點與跨域放置。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「RBAC」的資料、控制與時間關係。API 權限與容器內權限需分開。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立 namespace 操作矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「探針語義」的資料、控制與時間關係。Ready、live 與 startup 回答不同問題。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較慢啟動與失效情境。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驗收證據」的資料、控制與時間關係。Pod running 不等於服務可用。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「從使用者路徑核對成功率。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for desired state. Desired and observed state may temporarily differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reconciliation iterations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for etcd dependency. Control state depends on durable consistent storage. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate API and workload liveness. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for topology spread. Spreading replicas reduces common-failure exposure. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare same-node and cross-domain placement. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rbac. API rights differ from in-container rights. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a namespace action matrix. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for probe semantics. Readiness, liveness and startup answer different questions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare slow startup and failure cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acceptance evidence. Running pods do not establish service availability. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check success from the user path. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「排空與中止」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對 grace period 與最長請求。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「驗收證據」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「Pod running 不等於服務可用。」。
提交「驗收證據」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「從使用者路徑核對成功率。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit drain and termination input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit acceptance evidence two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit acceptance evidence input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：CPU 總量吻合就能忽略 affinity 排程。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Matching CPU totals permits ignoring affinity. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

related.title: 分散式共識服務
related.why: 控制狀態持久化需要共識
related.transfer: 控制狀態持久化需要共識
related.difference: 共識可用不代表節點可供排程
related.differenceEn: Consensus availability does not imply schedulable nodes
practice: 由「宣告狀態」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「共識可用不代表節點可供排程」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From desired state, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Consensus availability does not imply schedulable nodes", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
